checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both forearms remain on virtual floor; hands open.
checks.feet: Supporting toes retain floor contact; the other foot clears the floor, taps laterally and returns. Sides alternate.
checks.movement: Forearm plank with alternating lateral toe taps: each side 1.5 seconds out, 1 second toe contact, 1.5 seconds back. Moving toes briefly clear floor during each step; pelvis and arms remain fixed.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
